result.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
result.summary: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作基于预训练医学视觉-语言模型构建共享多模态大模型，利用配对肺 H&E 与空间转录组数据训练，并以任务特定解码支持组织/细胞分类、基因预测与条件表达补全等十三项任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于医学多模态的具体任务应用与基准刷分，缺少推理期状态生成、视觉证据筛选或停顿决策等机制，虽含自回归表达补全与图像置换消融，但无面向 LVR 的可核查方法线索，故排除。
